title: feat: update react instantsearch templates
body:
**Summary**

This PR removes the old React InstantSearch templates from CISA and replaces them with those based on Hooks, which are now the new default for React InstantSearch.

FX-2553

> **Warning**\
> Pipeline will fail until react-instantsearch and react-instantsearch-core v7 are released.
